    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Cell
    Represents a single cell in a Sudoku board.
    EndStage
    Manages the end/victory stage for the Sudoku application.
    GameController
    Controller for the Sudoku game view.
    GameStage
    Manages the game stage/window for the Sudoku application.
    ISolver
    Interface for Sudoku solver operations.
    IValidator
    Interface for Sudoku validation operations.
    Main
    Main entry point for the Sudoku application.
    MenuController
    Controller for the main menu view.
    MenuStage
    Manages the menu stage/window for the Sudoku application.
    SudokuBoard
    Represents the Sudoku board using a tree data structure.
    SudokuGenerator
    Generates random valid Sudoku puzzles.
    SudokuSolver
    Implementation of the Sudoku solver using backtracking algorithm.
    SudokuValidator
    Implementation of the Sudoku validator that checks if moves are valid.
    TreeNode
    Represents a node in the tree structure used to organize the Sudoku board.
    WinController
    Controller for the Win/End view.
